manifest.description.message: Online · No keys needed: Stocklake quotes delayed ~15 min, 25 a day free; a free key raises this to 200. Finnhub is optional for live US quotes.
manifest.description.description: Store listing; Online and Data delayed communicate network dependency and freshness

result.help.message: Try $AAPL, stock msft, or stock aapl msft nvda. Enter opens a chart; choose Copy or use stock copy AAPL to copy a quote.

quote.as_of.description: Actual last trade timestamp, not request time; preserve {time}

quote.cached.description: Time the saved quote was fetched; preserve {time}

quote.delayed.message: Data delayed / market may be closed
quote.delayed.description: Quote is over 15 minutes old; do not imply verified exchange status

quote.sampled.message: Locally sampled Finnhub quotes, with gaps. Collects while Stocks is used; this is not historical candle data.
quote.sampled.description: Sparkline accessible label and settings explanation

error.setup.message: Open Stocks settings, get a free Finnhub key, then Test and save it.

error.auth.message: The provider rejected the key. Open Stocks settings to test a replacement.
error.auth.description: Authentication error; never include the raw provider response

error.unknown.message: No quote for this symbol. Check the ticker and exchange suffix.

error.unsupported.message: This provider supports US tickers only. International exchange suffixes need a different data plan.

error.invalid_symbols.message: Enter stock symbols separated by spaces or commas, such as AAPL MSFT or BRK.B.

error.too_many.message: Use at most {max} symbols per query or watchlist.

error.rate_limit.message: Request limit reached. Showing saved data when available; requests will resume after a pause.

error.offline.message: Cannot reach the quote provider. Showing saved data when available.

error.unavailable.message: The quote provider is unavailable. Showing saved data when available.

error.busy.message: Another Kage window is refreshing quotes. Try again shortly.

error.storage.message: Quote storage is unavailable. Requests are paused until their limit can be tracked.
error.storage.description: Fail closed when rate budget cannot persist

error.invalid_key.message: Paste an API key for the selected provider, then Test and use. Do not paste a URL.

settings.description.message: Stocklake quotes work without a key: delayed ~15 min, 25 calls a day, or 200 with a free key. Finnhub offers live US quotes with a free key.

setup.intro.message: Finnhub needs a free key for live US quotes, with a limit of 60 calls per minute.

setup.terms.message: Use data for your own research and tools. Do not resell, redistribute or sublicense provider data or access, or circumvent limits. Check provider terms before sharing results.

setup.steps.message: Stocklake works immediately without a key. Choose a provider, optionally paste its key, then Test and use to save your choice.

setup.saved.message: A key is saved on this device. Leave the field empty to test it, or paste a replacement. Stored keys are never shown here.
setup.saved.description: Connected setup state without secret disclosure

setup.free_key.message: Get a free Finnhub key (about a minute)
setup.free_key.description: Open provider registration in system browser

setup.key_hint.message: Test and save stores the key in private extension data, like Spotify credentials. Typing it here does not save it with regular settings. This host's text field is visible while you type.

setup.test.description: Probe quote endpoint and save only on success

setup.remove.description: Delete provider credentials; retain cached quotes

setup.removed.message: Key removed. Saved quotes remain available.

setup.success.message: Quote test passed; provider selected and any supplied key saved.
setup.success.description: Successful guided setup; key is saved independently of watchlist settings

settings.watchlist_hint.message: Up to {max} symbols, separated by spaces or commas. Stocklake accepts international symbols such as SAP.DE; Finnhub supports US tickers. The panel requires a key and an enabled visibility setting.

settings.show.message: Show watchlist in the floating window

settings.refresh.description: Quote cache and widget refresh interval

settings.refresh_hint.message: Minimum {min} seconds; default {default}. Stocklake quotes are cached for at least 10 minutes; history for a day. Hidden-window polls pause. Finnhub reserves at most {budget} requests per minute locally.
settings.refresh_hint.description: Request budget and hidden behavior; preserve {min}, {default}, {budget}

settings.refresh_error.message: Refresh interval must be between {min} and {max} seconds.

tool.quote.message: Get stock quotes from your selected provider for your own use. Stocklake is delayed ~15 min and needs no key; Finnhub offers live US quotes with a key. Returns source, timestamps, freshness and per-symbol errors. Do not redistribute data.

tool.symbols.message: Up to {max} symbols, for example ["AAPL", "MSFT", "SAP.DE"]. Finnhub accepts US tickers only.

tool.history.message: Get real Stocklake daily history for 1d, 1w or 1m from a 30-trading-day window cached for a day. Costs one call on a cache miss. Finnhub returns incomplete locally observed quotes with no history request.
tool.history.description: Agent tool scope must not imply full historical coverage

tool.symbol.message: A stock symbol, including international suffixes for Stocklake.

error.timeout.message: The quote provider took too long to respond. Try again in a few seconds; showing saved data when available.
error.timeout.description: Request timeout; short local pause, separate from offline backoff

settings.agent_tools.description: Optional agent tool access; disabled by default

settings.agent_tools_hint.message: Agent tools may send quotes and results to your agent provider. Enable only for your own use when provider terms permit it. Takes effect after you restart Kage.
settings.agent_tools_hint.description: Explain opt-in and external agent data flow

settings.delete_quotes.description: Delete cached quotes and locally sampled history, retaining the key

settings.quotes_deleted.message: {deleted, plural, one {Deleted # saved quote or history record. Other windows or active refreshes may save more.} other {Deleted # saved quote or history records. Other windows or active refreshes may save more.}}{failed, plural, =0 {} one { # saved record could not be deleted. Try again.} other { # saved records could not be deleted. Try again.}}
settings.quotes_deleted.description: Deleted and failed record counts with ICU plurals; preserve {deleted} and {failed}; failures invite retry; concurrent windows may save records

widget.connection.message: Quotes need attention. Type stock and press Enter to open Stocks settings.
widget.connection.description: Compact widget hint for authentication or storage problems; keep stock as the launcher command

tool.opt_in.message: Enable Allow Stocks tools for agents in Stocks settings before using this tool. Check that provider terms permit your use with your agent provider.

settings.provider.description: Provider selection; Test/use persists the choice

setup.stocklake.message: Stocklake works without a key: delayed ~15 min, 25 calls a day; an optional free key raises this to 200.

setup.stocklake_key.description: Open Stocklake sign-in; emailed code; free 200 calls/day

quote.stocklake.description: Visible delayed provider attribution; paired with a link to stocklake.dev

quote.history.message: Stocklake daily closing prices for about 30 trading days. History is cached for a day; a cache miss uses one call. Finnhub sparklines use local samples.
quote.history.description: History accessible label and settings explanation; real daily data for Stocklake

error.daily_limit.message: Daily free quotes used up. Resets at {time}. Add a free Stocklake key for 200 a day.
error.daily_limit.description: Guest exhaustion message; preserve {time} for local reset time

error.key_daily_limit.message: Daily Stocklake calls used up. Resets at {time}. Showing saved data when available.
